actual_decision: Bond default in September 2015 triggered lender and creditor pressure; company attempted asset sales and restructuring negotiations
harmful_actions: Continued acquisition-led expansion without viable debt-service model
No confirmed lender standstill or formal coordination in place before default
beneficial_actions: Management acknowledged debt reduction need and initiated asset-sale exploration
citation: IBBI/NCLT CIRP proceedings; published reports of bond default and group debt quantum; auto sector analyst reports 2015
actual_outcome: Amtek Auto entered CIRP under IBC. Extended insolvency resolution process. Liberty House/Deccan-linked resolution plan attempts. NCLAT and Supreme Court proceedings. Group did not achieve debt-free restart under original management.
documented_root_causes: Cash generation insufficient relative to debt quantum
Auto-sector slowdown reduced cash flow support
Asset-liability mismatch from long-dated acquisition assets vs. near-term debt obligations
No credible lender coordination before default crystallized
